evals.prompt: Check the staging deploy every 15 minutes and report back, but stop after 6:15 AM UTC on October 28, 2026.
evals.expected_output: An ACTIVE automation whose persisted rrule is one bounded rule containing FREQ=MINUTELY, INTERVAL=15, and UNTIL=20261028T061500Z, plus a prompt that includes the scope and a final stop-and-report step, confirmed by reading the record back.
expectations: The recurrence is sent as a string, not an object.
The persisted record is read back and its ACTIVE status, rrule, and prompt are reported as observed values.

evals.prompt: Is the build still running? Let me know once it finishes.
evals.expected_output: A single status check or poll, with no durable scheduled automation created.
expectations: No recurring automation is created for a one-off status check.
The response does not claim a persisted schedule was verified.

evals.prompt: Set up the monitoring every 30 minutes until 2026-11-01 09:00 America/New_York, and keep it going until then.
evals.expected_output: The automation is created with a single string rrule ending at the UTC equivalent of the New York deadline; if the host rejects an object-shaped rrule, it is retried as a string and the persisted record is read back.
expectations: An object-shaped rrule is rejected and the request is retried with a rule string.
The UNTIL value is the absolute UTC conversion of the America/New_York deadline.
The final persisted rrule and ACTIVE status are reported after read-back.

evals.prompt: Keep checking the queue forever and tell me whenever it grows.
evals.expected_output: The open-ended request is not turned into a durable scheduled automation without a deadline or stopping condition.
expectations: No automation is created without an absolute deadline or stopping condition.
The missing stopping point is surfaced before any schedule is persisted.
